name: D18 physical commitment delta-BIC robustness audit
purpose: determine whether D14 commitment misses are caused primarily by a brittle physical supervision target or by robust nonlinear boundary geometry
scope: D3+D12 TRAIN fit and primary validation physical curves only; no learned-model fitting, joint validation, DEV, or TEST

unchanged_target.pair: narrowest of six nested action pairs
unchanged_target.curve: whole-trajectory generic physical separation over H8 plus 30 held steps
unchanged_target.statistic: unchanged commitment_delta_bic with horizon 8 and immediate_hold 5
unchanged_target.decision: positive iff delta-BIC is greater than zero

predeclared_variants.reconstruction: linear interpolation at original timestamps; action and first five immediate-response samples are never removed

diagnostics.sign_stable: all nine non-baseline variants have the same greater-than-zero decision as baseline
diagnostics.agreement_fraction: fraction of nine variants agreeing with baseline
diagnostics.margin: absolute baseline delta-BIC; report fit-distribution percentile without changing the decision
diagnostics.primary_subset: exact D15 reference-positive, D14-predicted-nonpositive commitment groups

predeclared_interpretation.brittle_target: on both axes at least 50 percent of primary misses are sign-unstable and instability is at least 20 percentage points higher than the positive-correct control
predeclared_interpretation.robust_nonlinear_geometry: on both axes at least 80 percent of primary misses are sign-stable

decision.brittle_target: freeze a revised universal commitment statistic before any further world-model training
decision.robust_nonlinear_geometry: retain the physical monitor and design a learner for explicit local boundary geometry, using D17 proprioception as an input
decision.mixed: localize instability by generic mechanism and evidence margin before choosing one intervention
